verdict.rationale: Trello documents a native integration ecosystem: Power-Ups for linking teams' favorite tools, an app directory, Slack and email capture into the Trello Inbox, a Jira list view, and calendar sync. Of the three named tools, though, only Slack is explicitly evidenced, and a community user reports add-on restrictions for solo users. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of native GitHub and Google Drive integrations, details on the depth of the Slack integration, independent hands-on corroboration of these integrations working.
